resources.string: FCM connection status and a quick Fix button
Keep notifications (FCM) from being blocked by HyperOS. Pick a method:
You can use both at once: the theme fixes the root cause in the ROM, Keep FCM alive is the backup layer.
Edit the ROM\'s hardcoded freeze list
Shares the list with “Keep FCM alive”. If you change the list, create the theme file again and re-import it.
Open the Themes app, apply the default theme again and reboot — everything goes back to normal.
▸ Advanced: theme reverts to default by itself?
The Themes app may restore the default theme for unofficial themes. Removing the Themes app (for the current user only) keeps the theme. Reinstall any time with Rollback. Needs Shizuku or root.

How it works: HyperOS Greezer (CN ROM) reads its freeze list from ROM resources, and GMS is hardcoded in the blacklist. MIUI themes may override these resources. The theme file only contains theme_values.xml — the look doesn\'t change.

Orange ⚡ = always in background. Grey ⚡ = only on message: may be frozen to save battery, thawed when an FCM message arrives. Tap ⚡ to change (opens the app\'s battery settings). Long-press an app to remove it.
